conflicts.permit: If you contact us, we will keep a record of that correspondence regardless of whether you have registered the account or not.
conflicts.prohibit: Child-users and unregistered users do not have the ability to provide any personal data when using the Apps beyond what has collected or used automatically (as noted above) and we do not collect or process any personal data of such users.
conflicts.situation: An unregistered user contacts the company via email or chat to ask a question or report a problem.
conflicts.reason: One clause explicitly states the company will keep correspondence records of unregistered users, while the other flatly asserts they do not collect or process any personal data of unregistered users.
